title: Blueberry Chia Jam (No Pectin)
excerpt: A homemade jam thickened with chia seeds, with far less sugar than the traditional kind and all the flavor of the blueberry.
imageAlt: Glass jar of homemade blueberry chia jam, a spread piece of toast and fresh blueberries
steps: Put the blueberries and the water in a small pot over medium heat.
Cook for 5–7 minutes, mashing the blueberries with a fork as they burst.
Remove from the heat and add the honey, lemon and chia. We use half the usual sweetener because Fresh Pick blueberries have more natural sugar.
Let it rest for 10 minutes so the chia thickens the mixture.
Transfer to a clean jar and refrigerate. It will thicken a bit more as it cools.
tips: It lasts up to 7 days in the fridge in an airtight jar, or up to 3 months frozen in portions.
Use it on toast, yogurt, oatmeal or as a pancake filling.
This recipe uses half the usual sweetener: Fresh Pick blueberries have more natural sugar, so we cut it back. Taste it and, if you prefer it sweeter, add a little more.
